limitations.quote: the first increment on the first rising edge after reset
limitations.note: The patch addressed a potential race on `bin_out` but left `gray_out` combinational, so the first Gray value appeared on the first rising edge instead of the second, as it would with the required output register.
The test expected the first increment on edge one, so it passed the early output and would have rejected the correct registered timing.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected and resubmitted with a different wrapper, after an earlier failed lookup of the knowledge base at a relative path.
